% Checks cases the fix of \pdfxformname must not break: a form placed with
% \pdfrefxform, and its name read inside the general text of \pdfliteral,
% which the PDF writes into the page's content and does not show. On the
% page the form is not drawn, and the text around each stays.
\pdfoutput=1
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Ref: \setbox2\hbox{form}\pdfxform2 before\pdfrefxform\pdflastxform{} after.

Literal: before\pdfliteral{q /Fm\pdfxformname\pdflastxform\space Do Q} after.
\end{document}
